verdict.rationale: First-party docs say users can 'Talk to Grok hands-free with voice' (grok-docs-40). The API offers streaming Speech to Text with a tunable voice-activity gate (grok-docs-4), which supports real-time voice interaction. The evidence is thin, though: a one-line consumer claim plus an STT parameter, with no detail on conversational latency, interruption handling or how natural the speech output sounds. missing for 10: documentation of real-time conversational behavior (latency, barge-in, natural TTS output), any realtime voice API details, and independent hands-on corroboration of voice mode quality.
